title: 有馬記念の後に・ジューショー？

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Spe and Grass are so tough to beat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition to Special Week and Grass Wonder, many other high-profile racers participated in this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's amazing that Haru Urara was even able to enter!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I did! Usually that's enough, but…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm… I'm not sure, but I feel… strange.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I did my best and had fun, but… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems confused by her emotions. She's truly at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Up until now, her desire to run has been fueling her, but other than that, nothing drives her to race. This may be my chance to give her a clear and fixed goal!
choice_data_list: I bet you'll figure it out if you try again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Try again? In the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's it! Running always helps me think!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I wanna enter the Arima Kinen again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure her loss is what's eating Haru Urara up inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I decide to train her for another year and have her enter the Arima Kinen again with a refreshed mindset.
choice_data_list: You'll need to win some graded races.
You'll need to win some graded races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order for her to qualify for the Arima Kinen, we'll have to improve her graded race results, popularity, and running abilities.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sooo… I have to get good grades and run hard?
choice_data_list: N-no, that's not what that means…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee. I can't wait for next year's Arima Kinen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I'll believe in Haru Urara's resolve. With this, Haru Urara's classic year comes to an end.
